```plato

// The Frenet-Serret frame of a space curve at one parameter value. Curvature is
// nonnegative (reciprocal world units); torsion (reciprocal world units) measures
// how fast the osculating plane rotates about the tangent. Undefined where
// curvature vanishes.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frenet%E2%80%93Serret_formulas)
type FrenetFrame3D
    implements IValue
{
    Position: Point3D;
    Tangent: Direction3D;
    Normal: Direction3D;
    Binormal: Direction3D;
    Curvature: Number;
    Torsion: Number;
}
```
